resources.string: Molasses watches only which of your chosen apps is in the foreground and when you scroll in it, so it can add deliberate friction as your usage adds up. It never reads the contents of your screen.

You have used this app for %1$d minutes in the current cycle. Clearing this gate unlocks the next five minutes. It does not reset your accumulated time and it does not reduce the delay on scrolling — the delay only ever grows within a cycle.
